name: Makino Ayako
source:
A beautiful woman, overflowing with motherliness. She is the target of the protagonist Takumi's affections.
She has always thought Takumi was a very cute boy.
Moved by Takumi's wishes, she surrenders her body to him.
Now she can no long resist the urge to copulate.

[From [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1018080&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
